title: Building With the Gemini API: The Part the Docs Don't Cover
description: The Gemini quickstart gets you a working call in ten lines. Everything that actually broke in my repo-analysis app happened somewhere else: choosing what to send, reading real error bodies, and handling a response that came back empty.
authorBio: Full-stack developer working with Next.js, Flask, MySQL and MongoDB. I write about the decisions behind the code, not just the syntax.
